# Warrior Trait

**Version 1.3** · for Crusader Kings III 1.20.* · [Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2250932791) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [All versions](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=warrior-trait&expanded=true)

Some rulers are good in a fight. These two cannot lose one.

**Warrior Trait** adds two traits, and lets you hand either to any character
in the world with a right-click.

**Warrior** is earned. It starts as a genuinely dangerous fighter and grows
every time that character personally wins a battle, until nobody can touch them.

**God Warrior** is given. Everything, immediately, forever. This is the
original trait this mod was built around, and it is unapologetically a cheat. If
you have ever wanted to watch one person walk into a war and end it, that is the
button.

Take the climb or skip it. The mod does not mind.

---

## How to use it

1. Right-click any character, yourself included.
1. Choose **Become A Warrior** or **Become A God Warrior** under friendly
  interactions.
1. That is it. It applies instantly.

A character can hold one or the other, not both. Either can be removed at any
time. Both are available in the **Ruler Designer** — Warrior for 150 points,
God Warrior for 500.

## Warrior: the climb

Winning a battle in person earns progress. Twenty commanded victories takes a
character from the first tier to the last.

- **From the start** — a strong commander with real prowess and more
  effective knights
- **As they win** — advantage climbs, terrain stops mattering, armies move
  faster, casualties fall away
- **At the top** — enormous prowess, battles that cannot realistically be
  lost, and no decline with age

It never quite reaches God Warrior. That is the point of God Warrior.

## God Warrior: everything at once

**The character**

- +50 Martial
- +100 Prowess
- Prowess never declines with age

**In battle**

- +100 Advantage, attacking or defending
- Minimum combat roll raised to 20, maximum to 40
- Takes no fatal casualties
- Doubles the enemy's fatal casualties
- No losses when retreating
- Strips enemies of their defensive advantage entirely

**On the march**

- Double movement speed on land and at sea
- No penalty for crossing water
- Double raid speed
- Immune to attrition in hostile counties

**Sieges and supply**

- Sieges resolve in a single phase
- Doubles the morale the defenders lose
- Siege weapons up to four times the usual size
- Ten times the supply duration, with double supply limit and capacity

**Beyond the battlefield**

- Knights five times as effective, and ten more of them
- A far larger men-at-arms cap
- Travel danger removed entirely, which matters enormously if you are playing
  landless
- Legitimacy and accolade glory arrive twice as fast

## Compatibility

- Updated for **CK3 1.20 "Crozier"** (By God Alone).
- **Ironman and achievements:** this mod adds traits, so it will disable
  achievements. That is the nature of the thing.
- **Other mods:** adds two new traits and four new interactions and changes
  nothing that already exists, so it should sit alongside almost anything. It does
  not overwrite any base game file.
- **Existing saves:** safe to add mid-game. Removing it mid-game is also
  fine, though any character carrying either trait will simply lose it.
- **Upgrading from an older version:** the trait named Warrior is now the
  one you earn, so an existing Warrior character starts at the bottom of the
  climb. Their old power is not gone — it is called God Warrior now, and one click
  restores it.

## Languages

Available in all nine languages the game supports. English is fully written; the
other eight currently show the English wording. If you would like to contribute
a translation, it is two short files and it would be very welcome.

## Install

- **Steam Workshop:** subscribe on the Workshop page above.
- **Manually, any version:** download `warrior-trait-v<version>.zip` from the [releases](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=warrior-trait&expanded=true) and extract it into `Documents/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/`, then enable it in the launcher.
